notes.title: Version 3.71
notes.content:
We know it’s been a while since you’ve heard from us, but trust us when we say we have not been resting on our laurels. We are currently working on two significant projects for you all. For those that don’t know QI Sports does not only want to make an excellent place for fans of the beautiful game but also have an ice hockey community too! We are currently working on adapting what we built for that world of ice and speed onto the same core platform that runs Kickoff Legends. As if that was not enough we are also working on bringing Kickoff Legends onto iOS. Both projects are advancing well, and a lot of this new build concerns those projects.

But here's a list of what you can already enjoy now!
We have worked hard on speeding up real-time connections between you and the server as well as you and your opponents, we are hoping to wrap up another speed-up project within the next few daysWe have added staff level-up notifications and wall postsWe have added new League Rewards (passer, tackler, and bully) so now every aspect of the player league leaderboard is rewarded.Changed Subs icon in Game SceneDisplay Subs on live matches on wallOne Free Item for each new team, this means that when someone creates a team, they receive one free bonus item to improve their team. Tell all your friends! They just might beat you on their first day (if they play their strategies right that is off course). Always remember for each friend that you bring to Kickoff Legends, you get rewarded
Also, always remember, the game is available on Android, Steam and the browser! So all your friends can play too! You can start on any platform and continue playing on another and all platforms can play against each other!

Now get back out there!

notes.title: Version 3.65
notes.content:
Having given you a better way to plan ahead this time around we are adding a whole new strategic aspect to the game allowing you to give your team instructions as to how much you want to push ahead on the field. 

https://i.imgur.com/vIuACIG.png
You will now find Mentality as part of your team strategy. This tells your players how far you want them push up the field. League matches now reduce match count, so make sure you play those obligatory matches first! Comments now boost wall posts again, if a post is commented on, it will now be moving up the wall. Active items are now taken into account when you use the Auto button in the Lineup Tool
Fixes 
If you use the team energy replenish in the lineup tool, the list of players is now updated following that purchase. It was already the case, it's just that you didn't see it, which caused some confusion. Always remember that we can't do this without your feedback, it's what keeps us up at night. Do you miss a strategy? Do you want a specific type of player. Do you think that players need a new ability? Get in touch and let us know!
Also, the game is available on Android, Steam and the browser!

notes.title: Version 3.64
notes.content:
Being in charge of a team you need not only to make the right decision during a match, but you also need to plan ahead. Today’s release helps you with with just that!
We have replaced the Player Offers section with Contracts, you will now be able to see how your team will look like in the next 5 seasons! Make sure that your team respects the salary cap. Start training your younger players in time. The Contract section also shows pending contract offers.When you are in the Market for a new player the lists of free agents and last season players now also displays the salary a player expects. Like this you don’t have to click on each player that is interesting to you only to find out that you can’t afford him.Bottom three teams of leagues that are higher than Level 1 are now demoted. Always remember, the higher the league level, the higher the reward for a league team and player reward.
Several Fixes: 
There is still the problem with a match hanging at the start of either period, we are actively working on this issue so you don’t have to reload anymore when this happens. We’re not quite done, but we’re getting there.The Coach achievement is now functioning correctly again. There where some issues with several of the formations causing players to go wander off their starting positions for no apparent reason. This has been fixed
Always remember that we can't do this without your feedback, it's what keeps us up at night. Do you miss a strategy? Do you want a specific type of player. Do you think that players need a new ability? Get in touch and let us know!

Also, the game is available on Android, Steam and the browser!

notes.title: Version 3.40
notes.content:
When building your dynasty it's important to convince your players to stick around to see the project until the end. There is a famous saying, and it goes like so "Money talks!". When you offer one of your own players a contract you can now offer them a non-compete clause. This means that the player will not be taking any more offers from any other teams. Gone are the days of exclusive Friday's but at least you can hold on to your player if you are willing to pay him to stay. 

On to the full list of new features: 

Golden generation to boost average of players older than 32 years
New kids on the block to boost average of players younger than 22
Shin pads to improve player tackling
Different shoes to boost player speed/passing/shooting 
Goal keeper gloves to improve your goalies Technical abilities
Speed up the match up in the lobby, opponent (or bot) now joins the game much faster
When you click fast forward during a match, the 
You can now purchase energy drinks to boost your players stamina
You can now login with Steam from the game site. Start playing in steam then pick up the same match from another machine!
New non-compete clause to player offer. If you want to make a final offer to a player, you can pay an additional amount to freeze the offers. Only works if this is your player. This also means that we are removing the Friday offer freeze, in favor of the new non-compete clause.
New Inventory widget in the header of the dashboard. Always make sure you have an active item to give your team the best possible chance when playing a match!


Always remember that we can't do this without your feedback, it's what keeps us up at night. So get in touch and let us know where you would like to see changes!

Also, remember the game is also available on Android and Browser!

notes.title: Version 3.25 and 3.26
notes.content:
Releasing 3.25 and migrating to new servers last Monday was so exciting we forgot to publish the patch notes! So here is 3.25 from Monday and the new version released today, 3.26:

3.25 

A first iteration of the achievement system. In your Team section you will now get a list of achievements allowing you to continue to work your way towards glory!
New web notifications! We have added browser notifications to the game for those of you using that as your primary client. 
Small refresh to the design
Added Goals and played matches to your team player list
Move game to new servers.


3.26 

This one goes hand in hand with the other release made last Monday. It adds 4 new achievements and a few fixes about the new achievement page. Hope you like it!


The Spender : Buy 5 free agents from the market.
The Galacticos : Buy 11 Star player in the market! The price doesn't matter, but it needs to be a star player.
No longer friends : Beat your friends 50 times. If you value your friendship, we suggest you beat different friends :)
The Mad Hatter (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond) : Five levels for this achievement, every time you score a hat trick you get closer to marvellous rewards.


We are looking closely at the stability of the game on the new servers, but if you notice something weird, please do contact us!
See you on the pitch!

notes.title: Version 3.24
notes.content:
Happy new year to y'all! 2017. We have three new formations for you to best meet your opponents. We will be adding more as time passes. Please feel free to request new ones too! So without any further ado, here we go!

 - Tutorial all displayed on dashboard instead of moving all around the site. No longer triggering a fast forward at the end of the first match. This should help new owners to better enter the game. 
 - Following user requests we give younew formations! 3-4-3, 4-3-2-1, 4-2-3-1. Want more? Just ask!
 
 Bug fixes
 - Challenges are now working correctly
 - No longer re-assigning jersey numbers on lineup change. Special thanks to Parcselona for this one!

We are developing at breakneck speed deploying a new version at least once week, more often twice. So off course we want to make sure that our focus is at the right place. So in short, if you could take a moment to fill out this form (see link in-game) it would really be helpful to use as we move forward. To make it a little interesting the 5 best answers will receive a $25 Amazon Gift certificate. The winners will be announced on the Kickoff Legends Facebook Page.

As always, if you have an Android device, install the app! If you have a problem with the game send us a message on Facebook, Twitter or the Steam Community.

As usual, if you questions, issues or ideas, please contact us!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26689010/63f765011f52a48e0cd6e74e76ff1329852b2e66.png

notes.title: Version 3.23
notes.content:
Another release for this week! 
This one brings a few new features :

- Revamped Watch player widget on dashboard. Added a new button "Remove from watch list". More infos about the current contract (salary, duration).

- Bench size has been increased to 5! Substitution are still limited to 3 per game, but at least now you can choose the right player for the right job.
Even faster fast forward! Try it and let us know what you think!


As for the bug fixes:

- Major issue about team creation on Android

As usual, if you questions, issues or ideas, please contact us or leave us a message in the Steam Community!

notes.title: Release 3.22.1
notes.content:
This release brings much needed fixes :
- Small tweaks on team creation step. Labels are clearer, button always shown but grayed out when disabled.
- Failing pending offers not being run on league maintenance
- All new players were assigned the number 11

A big thank you to the MasterArmy for the video that helped shape this release.

notes.title: Version 3.22
notes.content:
This new version fix two critical bugs:

- Unable to start a game if you're coming from the team section
- Tutorial could get stuck if you closed the game without completing it.

Some minor bugs:
- Unable to delete some notifications

We also worked to improve the general performance of the game and when retrieving informations about the leagues.

We are aware of another bug, jersey numbers are all set to 11. This is being worked on.

Thank you everyone for reporting the bugs! Don't hesitate to contact us via the community tools or via Facebook if you find more bugs, have questions or just want to say hi ːsteamhappyː.
